en.emptyDescription: Create a local note or add a Gist file to get started.
en.tokenPlaceholder: Personal access token with gist scope
en.tokenHint: Stored in this browser's localStorage. Use only on trusted devices.
en.documentsDescription: Local notes can be pushed directly to GitHub. Existing Gist files can also be added here.
en.removeEntryConfirm: Remove “{name}” from this notebook? Its local copy and history will also be deleted.
en.localFilenameHint: Enter the complete file name, including an optional extension. Leave the extension out for a plain file.
en.localOnlyHint: This note is stored in this browser. Push can create a Gist for it.
en.statusSyncCancelled: Synchronization cancelled. Local and remote files were not changed.
en.statusAllSynced: This file matches its last synced version.
en.statusSaveFailed: Could not save to browser storage. Copy your text before closing this page.
en.statusStorageChanged: This note was changed in another tab. Your current editor was not overwritten.
en.statusTabLimit: You can open up to {count} tabs at once.
en.statusFileLimit: You can register up to {count} files.
en.statusFileAddedTabs: Added {count} file(s) and opened {opened} tab(s). Close a tab to open the rest.
en.statusLocalFileCreatedClosed: Created local file: {name}. Close another tab to open it.
en.statusCurrentFileNotLinked: The current document is local only. Push it to create or connect a Gist.
en.statusNoPushChanges: {name} has no local changes to push.
en.statusPullConflict: This document ({name}) has local edits. Pull will replace them with the latest Gist file ({remote}). Continue?
en.statusPushConflict: The Gist file ({remote}) has changed since the last sync. Push will overwrite it with the current local contents of {name}. Continue?
en.statusPullMissing: The linked Gist file ({remote}) for {name} no longer exists. Local contents were left unchanged.
en.statusPushMissing: The linked Gist file ({remote}) for {name} no longer exists. Recreate it in GitHub before pushing again.
en.statusPushOutdated: The uploaded snapshot is synced, but newer local edits remain.
en.statusFileTooLarge: This file exceeds the local editing limit of {size}. It was not changed.
en.statusFileTruncated: GitHub did not return the full contents of “{name}”. The file was not loaded.
en.errorGistIdRequired: Enter a valid Gist URL or ID.
en.errorGistNotFound: Could not read this Gist. Check its ID and token.
en.errorGistFilesEmpty: This Gist does not contain any files.
en.errorFilenameRequired: Select at least one available file.
en.errorDuplicateEntry: That Gist file is already registered.
en.errorInvalidLocalFilename: The file name contains invalid characters or ends with a dot or space.
en.errorDuplicateLocalFilename: A local document with this name already exists.
en.errorTokenRequired: A GitHub token is required for this action.
en.errorEditorFontSize: Choose a font size between 8 and 72 pixels.
en.errorLocalChangedDuringPull: Local content changed while Pull was running. The remote data was not applied.
en.errorLocalChangedDuringPush: Local content changed while Push was checking the Gist. Nothing was uploaded.
en.confirmPullOverwrite: Pull replaces local edits with the current Gist contents. Continue?
en.confirmPushOverwrite: Push overwrites the newer Gist contents with your local edits. Continue?
en.remoteMissingHint: This file is missing on GitHub. It cannot be pulled until it is restored.
en.saveLocalOnlyHint: Save stores the current note in this browser. Push creates or updates its Gist on GitHub.
en.storageWarning: Browser storage is limited. Keep important notes synced and maintain a backup.
en.statusEditorFallback: CodeMirror could not be loaded. The editor is using the basic text area without syntax highlighting or search tools.
en.statusMyGistsLoaded: Loaded {count} Gist file(s). Select one file to add.
en.statusNoGists: No Gist files were found in this account.
en.promptSelectMatchingGist:
Several Gists contain the file “{filename}”. Enter the number to select one:
{choices}
en.confirmOverwriteSameNameGist: The Gist “{description}” ({gistId}) already contains “{filename}”. Overwrite this file?
en.confirmCreateGistForLocalFile: No Gist contains “{filename}”. Create a new Gist?
en.gistSecretHint: Secret Gists are unlisted, not private. Anyone with the link can view them.
en.statusGistCreated: Created a new Gist and linked {name}.
en.statusGistUpdated: Overwrote the matching Gist file and linked {name}.
en.errorSelectOneGistFile: Select exactly one file from a Gist.
